title: ChannelPartner
description: Schema for a Channel Partner that can process NSFDC/NBCFDC/NSKFDC loan schemes. Channel Partners include State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), Public Sector Banks (PSBs), Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and NBFC-MFIs.

name.description: Full name of the channel partner

type.description: Type of channel partner: State Channelizing Agency, Public Sector Bank, Regional Rural Bank, or NBFC-MFI

district.description: District where the partner branch is located

latitude.description: Latitude of the partner branch (India range: ~6-37°N)

longitude.description: Longitude of the partner branch (India range: ~68-98°E)

scheme_categories_processed.description: List of scheme IDs this partner can process (e.g., ['NSFDC_MCF', 'NSFDC_TL'])

fund_utilization_pct.description: Current fund utilization percentage (how much of allocated funds are already committed). Higher = less capacity.

npa_pct.description: Net Non-Performing Assets percentage. NSFDC requires RRBs to have NPA < 15% for eligibility.

is_active.description: Whether the partner is currently accepting new applications
